Nora: Quick exec pulse: three short updates + two asks. Please ACK.
Ben: Perf snapshot: rolling median latency 38ms, p95 220ms, request rate +15% WoW. No major incidents.
Carlos: Product/GTM: Private GA timeline holding at 2026-05-20. Sales enablement doc ready, need final pricing alignment with Finance.
Mei: Reliability note: we've seen two small autoscaler flaps during the EU morning window. Root cause appears to be a race in scale-in heuristics. Patch queued.
Dana: Support metrics: CSAT 4.6/5 this week; escalations down but response SLA slipping to 6h due to onboarding volume. We'll triage with staffing.
Nora: Asks: 1) Finance + Product to lock GA pricing floor by Friday EOD. 2) Eng & SRE to propose a 48h mitigation plan for p95 regressions (one-line each).
finance-bot: [Report] Current margin simulation at proposed GA prices: gross margin 42% (target floor 38%). See spreadsheet: https://drive.redwood/pricing/ga-sim-2026
Ben: For p95 mitigation (one-liners): enable conservative batching for eu clusters; increase KV cache freshness TTL; enable alternative kernels for long-token requests.
Mei: Mitigation plan (one-liner): revert scale-in aggressiveness, add 2m cooldown, run canary patch during low-traffic window Thu 02:00 UTC.
Carlos: Pricing input: recommend two-tiered GA pricing (base + premium low-latency SLA) to protect margin while offering predictable latency for enterprise. Will send proposal link.
Nora: Also flag: legal needs one extra week for a data processing agreement template. If delayed, GA signoff might slip. Add to risk register.
Dana: Staffing ask: temporary support contractors for initial GA weeks to keep response SLA <4h. People ops is ok pending budget OK from Finance.
Ben: Ops action: I'll open a short-run perf experiment to test batching tweaks across three regions. Command to run tests locally: `rdw loadtest --profile p95-tune --regions eu-west,us-west,ap-sg`
finance-bot: [Reminder] Budget check: growth spend for May ramp requires approval. Approvers: Nora, CFO.
Nora: TL;DR: lock pricing floor, short mitigation plan for p95, confirm temporary support plan. Managers: add a 1-line status to the GA rollout doc by Friday. We'll review on Monday leadership sync. Thanks :sparkles:
